summary_1line: Ravana abducts Sita; Jatayu heroically fights and dies; Rama learns the truth, performs Jatayu’s rites, and begins searching southward.

image_candidates.scene_text: The giant vulture Jatayu attacks Ravana mid-air, tearing at him with talons as Ravana holds the struggling Sita.
Sita drops her ornaments and a bright yellow cloth from the sky toward five monkeys watching from a mountain peak below.
The dying wingless Jatayu lies on the forest ground as Rama and Lakshmana kneel beside him with drawn bows.
